sections.overview: This eartheater is the geographically unusual Panamanian member of Geophagus, recorded on both Atlantic and Pacific slopes of central and eastern Panama. The Catalog of Fishes also records Colombia, whereas FishBase summarizes the range as Panama.
sections.identification: The species is valid in the Catalog of Fishes, although some specialist accounts put its genus name in quotation marks because its placement within the steindachneri group remains unsettled.
sections.habitat: FishBase reports it from freshwater streams with moderate to fast flow over small stones, sand, rock and leaf debris.
sections.diet: Species-specific prey data are limited; a specialist account describes substrate-sifting and stomach contents for the broader steindachneri group, not a direct species-level diet study.
sections.behavior: Detailed ecology available is largely group-level; the sources used here do not establish species-specific social behavior.
sections.reproduction: A specialist aquarium account describes maternal mouthbrooding in the steindachneri group, but this is treated as group-level evidence rather than a firm species-specific observation.
sections.ecology: It differs geographically from G. argyrostictus of the Xingu and G. brokopondo of Suriname, described in the companion profiles.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists global Least Concern from an assessment dated 2 August 2019.
